```regex
^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$
```

This matches `12345` and `12345-6789`. The anchors `^` and `$` make it match the whole string, so `123456` or `12345-67` won't match. If you're searching text for ZIP codes instead of validating a single value, drop the anchors and add word boundaries: `\b\d{5}(-\d{4})?\b`.

It checks the format only. It doesn't confirm that the code is assigned to a real area.
